text.body: āryāpañcadaśīstotram || karakalitacāpabāṇāṃ kalhārāṅghriṃ namāmi kalyāṇīm | kaṃdarpadarpajananīṃ kaluṣaharāṃ kāmitārthaphaladātrīm || 1 || eṣā stotum vāṇī naiva samarthā taveśi mahimānam | śeṣo'pyabdasahasraiḥ śeṣaṃ kṛtavān maheśi tava caritam || 2 || īśitvādisupūjyāmindindirakeśābhārasūllasitām | indīvaradalanayanāmīpsitadātrīṃ namāmi śarvāṇīm || 3 || lasadaruṇabhānukoṭidyutinidhimambāṃ surendralakṣyapadām | lalitāṃ namāmi bāle lalitaśivahṛdayakamalakalahaṃsīm || 4 || hrīṃkārabījarūpe himagirikanye harīndrabhavavandye | himakaradhavalacchatre hitāya bhava naḥ sadā mahārājñi || 5 || harṣotkarajanayitrī hasitajyotsnā taveyamanavadye | haragalahālāhalamapi harati trailokyamohatimiraṃ te || 6 || sakalamanorathadāne satyapi caraṇe natasya tava nipuṇe | saṃsevyate surataruḥ sadājñalokairnu kṛcchraphaladātā || 7 || kanakaruce caṭulagate kaṭhinastanabhāranamrakṛśamadhye | kānte kaṅkaṇahaste kambugrīve namo'stu te karuṇe || 8 || haranayanānandakare harāṅkasaṃsthe haripramukhavandye | haranaṭanasākṣibhūte harārdhadehe namo'stu te sukṛpe || 9 || lakṣmīpradakaruṇā yā lakṣmīpatimalpamamba kartumalam | lakṣyam kuru māṃ tasyā lāvaṇyāmṛtataraṅgamāle tvam || 10 || hrīṃkāraratnagarbhe hemācalamandarastanollasite | herambapriyajanani he vasudhe dehi me kṣamāṃ nityam || 11 || satsaṃpradāyavidite sakalāgamanigamasāratattvamayi | sāvitryarpaya vadane sakalarasāśrayasuvāksudhādhārām || 12 || karakaṅkaṇamaṇidinamaṇikaravikasitacaraṇakamalamakarandam | karuṇāpayonidhe me kāmākṣi svāntaṣaṭpadaḥ pibatu || 13 || lasadikṣucāpasumaśaralakṣitadorvallivīryamabhayena | lakṣādhikadaityakulaṃ lavupaṭavāsaṃ kṛtaṃ kathaṃ citram || 14 || hrīṃkārakelibhavane himakaramaulyaṅkamañjuparyaṅke | hṛdayasaroje me vasa hṛdayānandaprabodhaparahaṃsi || 15 || āryāpañcadaśīṃ tāmāryāṃ yo bhajati śuddhadhīrnityam | bhārye lakṣmīvāṇyau paryātāt tasya sādaraṃ bhavataḥ || 16 || ityānandanāthapādapadmopajīvinā kāśyapagotrotpannenāndhreṇa tyāgarājanāmnā viracitamāryāpañcadaśīstotraṃ saṃpūrṇam
